svg.title: The tangent model at 0.25 m
svg.desc: For a 0.001 cubic metre per second step, the tangent model at 0.25 metres follows the tank and ends 0.0026 metres below it, within the 0.005 metre requirement; for a 0.005 step it starts on the tank but ends 0.061 metres below, because the outflow curve bends away from its tangent.
svg.text: The tangent at 0.25 m: right for a small step, wrong for a large one
Control Studio project experiment · two equal gravity tanks from 0.25 m · steps at 2 s · numbers answer the predictions
25 s = τ: the line has covered 64 % of its rise
Large step ends 0.061 m apart: fails
